title: Focused replies
description: Tap a quoted reply or Show replies to open its native thread, including ancestors outside the cached timeline and nested replies. The parent stays mounted. Loading, partial and unavailable context are explicit; no original message is invented.

title: Separate reply draft
description: A focused thread keeps its own draft and exact reply target. Returning preserves the parent draft and reading place; reopening restores the thread draft. Text, photos and voice use the same native target.

title: Replies: failure and retry
description: Keep the normal conversation header and back control above a centered error and Retry. A successful retry restores the actual thread; the isolated DEMO deliberately refuses the first request.

title: Eligible message actions
description: A vertical action list sits below the reaction bar; no wrapped action grid. Edit and Undo Send still require server-qualified own iMessages within their allowed time and edit count.

title: Edit a bubble
description: Edit in a bubble with the sent bubble’s round corners and small circular cancel/confirm controls beside it. The parent composer draft remains independent; a real confirming update applies the edit.

title: Available edit history
description: The existing edit-history sheet, recaptured with clean synthetic wording: “Coffee at nine.” becomes “Coffee at ten.” Missing versions remain explicit; no history is invented.

title: Edit: keep the rejected draft
description: A refusal keeps the exact clean edit draft and circular controls with one inline error. Retry changes the server text exactly once and retains the original version.

title: Undo Send notice
description: A confirmed unsent fact replaces that message with a notice and clears its cached text, media, reactions and quoted content. A stale history page cannot resurrect it. Existing ordinary deletion remains separate. Recipient behavior is not established by this DEMO.

title: Search the full conversation
description: One top bar provides back, search field with inline clear, and Find, with 8dp gaps. The native keyboard Search key also runs the query. Full-history result rows and matching-text highlights are retained.

title: Open an exact match
description: The normal conversation header stays at the top. An accent outline highlights the matched bubble; timestamp separators are retained. Match chevrons and “1 of 11” sit in a bottom bar above the composer. Scrolling loads older/newer context without paging buttons or false new-arrival pills.

title: No results and clear
description: A completed scan can report no results. The same single search bar retains its inline clear; clearing resets the results. Incomplete scans still offer More results.

title: Search: failure and retry
description: Keep the search bar/back and conversation scope above a centered error and Retry. The query and parent draft survive refusal and successful retry.

title: Search · unfolded
description: The same revised single search bar at the unfolded size. Captured after explicitly reopening search in the settled workspace; this is not evidence of uninterrupted modal retention during folding.

title: Replies · unfolded
description: The unfolded size of the same focused Replies pane and its separate saved draft. Returning restores the existing conversation workspace and Shared pane.
